grift.kind: published vector paths, not raw measurements
grift.velocity_legend_audit: Fig8d dashed matches dX/dt; solid matches dY/dt. Duration is inferred using positions and velocities only.
grift.force_basis: Measured Fn,Ft use the shaft/transducer basis n=(-cos(theta),-sin(theta)), t=(sin(theta),-cos(theta)), also for beta15. Blade chord rotates by theta+beta. Independently checked against Fx,Fy.
notes: Do not count Fig22 beta0 or Fig10 as independent validation.
Measured water forces already have dry blade/strut inertia subtracted.
Plot sampling density does not equal experimental sample count.
Only 0<=phase<=1 kinematics available. No verification of recovery or the full release tail.
